programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: Amy's father, Dan, escaped the Vietnam War when he was a young boy; Amy knows little about her dad's past and wishes she could connect with him better; together, they travel to Vietnam to explore the country and Dan's history.

programs.title: Phantom Signals
programs.desc: When someone picks up a radio distress call from a seven-year-old boy lost alone in the desert, authorities embark on a search-and-rescue mission to find him; as the hunt continues, the case becomes more and more mysterious.

programs.title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
programs.desc: Billions of years ago, the first sign of life emerged on Earth; how exactly did this miraculous event unfold? As we probe the past, astronomers turn their telescopes to exoplanets to uncover vital clues about our own origins on planet Earth.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programs.desc: At the sacrificial altar El Castillo, where thousands met their death, researchers find new evidence that could shed light on the Maya; a sacred well at Chichen Itza where thousands were deposited and ceramic pieces at Khonkho Wankane mortuary.

programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid
programs.desc: A visit to a late 1700s mansion now bed and breakfast in New Orleans' Garden District gets off to a surprising start when an event from above startles the investigators.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: Tensions build between team members as their search for the lost Viking continues, taking them into Minnesota to examine the fabled Kensington Runestone; deep analysis of the Runestone takes place alongside the search at the find site.

programs.title: Alien Corridors
programs.desc: There is high strangeness on Archuleta Mesa; it's no wonder, with the whisperings of an underground alien base; could Area 51 have been an elaborate decoy all along?

programs.title: To Kill a Dictator
programs.desc: Over 30 years, Rafael Trujillo spearheads massacres, tortures, imprisons, and murders anyone who dares to voice dissent; in response, the Dominican Liberation Movement organizes military operations, to take out the fearsome regime.
